page.overview:
Who is Garakuta Gang Leader?

He is a fairly large man with short dark hair and a beard. There are two scars on his face - one is long on the right side, and the other is small and is located under the left eye. He wears a black turtleneck over which he wears a long-brimmed burgundy tank top, light-coloured pants tied with a lilac belt, and a pair of high-top boots. He has long wristbands on his arms, and a dark travel cloak is draped over his shoulders.

He is a rather rude and arrogant person who, in order to achieve his goal, does not hesitate to attack defenceless people and young genin girls. He is quite greedy and seeks to steal things that can make a lot of money, such as the First Hokage's scroll.

He has some skills in ninjutsu being able to use the Earth Release to create a swamp that sucks in and immobilizes people.

He has highly developed leadership qualities, as he is able to lead and command a large number of people. The members of the Garakuta Gang obey him unquestioningly and, for the most part, follow orders even if they are afraid. In addition, he is quite smart and guessed that the merchants would deceive him, for which he sent water clones as a decoy, making sure that the leader of the enemy group went after them, and he himself hid in the forest and attacked the almost defenceless merchants.
